goal: Add a login feature to the Todo app

nodes.task: Add a POST /login endpoint to app/main.py. Request body: {"username": string, "password": string}. Accept exactly one hard-coded demo user (username "demo", password "demo123") and reply 200 with {"token": string, "userId": integer} (userId is 1 for the demo user); any other credentials reply 401 by raising HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="invalid credentials") (FastAPI then returns the JSON body {"detail": "invalid credentials"} — do not wrap detail in another dict). Generate the token with secrets.token_hex(16). Add tests in tests/test_login.py for the success and the 401 case. Run the full test suite and make it pass. Then publish the request and response JSON Schemas.

Add a login form to static/index.html above the todo list: username and password fields plus a Login button. On submit, POST JSON to the backend endpoint given in context using EXACTLY the request field names from backend:request_schema, and read EXACTLY the response field names from backend:schema. On success, hide the form, store the token in memory, and show 'Signed in as <username>'. On 401, show 'Invalid credentials' inline. Do not break the existing todo functionality. Report the response schema you coded against as schema_used, copied verbatim from context.

The backend/ and frontend/ trees have already been merged at the run root by the system. Run `python -m pytest -q tests` at the run root. If anything fails, fix only genuine integration issues without editing tests or the API. Report merged_files (from context), tests_passed, the last 20 lines of test output, and a summary.

Verify the merged app at the run root is ready to ship the login feature. Run the tests yourself, inspect app/main.py for the login endpoint and static/index.html for the login form and matching field names, and note any production risks. Produce the go/no-go decision with a checklist.
